events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history, opened its gates in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million gathered for three days of peace, love, and music. What's your ultimate Woodstock track?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who died on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, we lost the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley. His legacy lives on.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: The hip-hop world marks the anniversary of the tragic shooting of Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, whose powerful voice and lyrics continue to resonate decades after his passing.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Music fans remember the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: A true guitar pioneer, Jimi Hendrix, left us too soon on this day in 1970. His sound changed everything.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in 1969, featuring that legendary zebra crossing artwork.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! What's your favourite Oasis or solo track from the rock 'n' roll star?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the US on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released the powerful message of 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates globally.

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed personal music forever. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Fans worldwide celebrate Global James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Which 007 film or theme tune is your all-time favourite? Licence to thrill!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music still inspires.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! A true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album,' in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece – what's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: We remember the incredible voice and stage presence of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the phenomenal Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.
